comment_regular: Verified post-A* road augmentation. It walks TravelPath nodes, switches to the linked door's WorldSpace and TeleportData marker position on teleport transitions, then asks that world's TESRoad to add surface-derived position nodes for applicable segments. TravelPath_ComputeDistance subsequently sums the added node segments, so road data changes the measured travel distance; this is route measurement/surface sampling, not the A* route search.
